_comment: Market session timings per exchange and segment. CURATED: timings are set by
exchange circulars and change rarely, but they DO change (MCX evening close,
pre-open mechanics, proposed F&O extensions). Published with provenance:'curated'.
- Times are IST, 24h HH:MM. `days` defaults to Mon-Fri.
- `kind` drives the UI: pre | normal | post | special.
- When a close time varies (MCX / US daylight saving), state BOTH in `note`
rather than pretending one number is always right.
- Trading-holiday calendars are yearly circulars - link to them, never copy them.
notes: All sessions run Monday to Friday and are suspended on exchange trading holidays; check each exchange's holiday calendar.
Both equity exchanges hold a special ~1-hour Muhurat trading session on Diwali evening; the exact window is announced by circular each year.
Timings are reproduced from exchange material and reviewed manually. Verify against the exchange before acting on an edge case.
